lines: This dam in China made every day on Earth a little longer.
The Three Gorges Dam is 181 meters tall and more than 2 kilometers long.
Its reservoir stretches about 600 kilometers up the Yangtze River.
More than a million people had to move to make room for the water.
Its turbines can produce 22,500 megawatts. The most of any power station on the planet.
And NASA calculated that moving all that water made Earth's day 0.06 microseconds longer.
Follow for a new megaproject every day.
